title: Samtavisi Cathedral
visualBrief: Individual Samtavisi Cathedral main church:cream/tan rectangular stone body with red-tile central nave/cross gables and lower lean-to roofs,tall12-sided narrow-window drum,brown-gray conical roof/cross. Decorated east facade has two actual deep pointed V-section recesses,large geometric cross/slit field,round blind arcades,rosettes and paired diamond relief. Southern transverse gable carries high slit/round relief,with blind lower bays and a recessed small western-side door. Shared256-square masonry/limestone/tile/standing-seam metal/wood graphs,four browser levels,metric UVs/linear tints/flat normals. Separate compound bell tower/ruins excluded;fine carvings,interiors/engineering,hidden rear details and exact ground join simplified or unverified.
